International scholarships
Overseas students enrolling in our undergraduate and postgraduate programmes may be eligible for scholarships of up to £6,000 per year, depending on their chosen course.

Eligibility

Applicants who have accepted their offer and enrolled for an undergraduate or a postgraduate course with Ravensbourne University London and are classified as overseas students for fee purposes. For full information about our available scholarships, explore below.

Early bird discounts
In addition to our scholarships, you can also take advantage of our early bird discounts when you pay your fees early. We reward students who plan ahead, making it easier and more affordable to secure your place and prepare for life in the UK.

Choose the option that suits you best:
Pay in stages and save:
Get £500 off when you pay at least £2,000 of your tuition fees 60 days before Welcome Week
Plus £400 off when you pay the rest of your tuition fees before you travel to the UK.
OR

Pay in full early
Get a £1,000 discount when you pay your full tuition fees 60 days before Semester 1 starts.
